Books, playlists, and tools useful across **multiple** lecture series. Course-specific lists stay under each course (e.g. [MFML references](../courses/mfml/references.qmd)).

## Foundations

| Resource | Why |
|----------|-----|
| *Mathematics for Machine Learning* (Deisenroth et al.) — free PDF | Linear algebra, calculus, probability refresh |
| First course notes on probability (any solid undergrad text) | Sample space, RV, distributions, densities |

| Python + NumPy / Matplotlib | Tutorials |
| Jupyter / Quarto notebooks | Hands-on lecture demos |
